topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct acknowledged at hire and annually; sanctions in POL-01 4.8
Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk reports; Director of Security has direct access to the chair
evidence: Audit committee minutes (4 quarterly reports, 2025-12 to 2026-09)

control_description: Roles in POL-01; HIPAA Security Official designated; system owner and control owners named in the SSP
Hiring standards, background checks, annual training, secure coding training for engineers
gap: No role training for support agents (support view, customer data) or the machine learning team (AI risks); security team of 6 is stretched (P01 R-049)
remediation: Role training modules; 3 approved security and GRC hires

control_description: Control owners accountable through the GRC tool and quarterly performance objectives; sanctions applied
Asset inventory, data map, and logs support controls
gap: Inventory misses sandboxes and SaaS integrations; data map missed the warehouse copy; data-level logs absent (POAM-004, POAM-012)
remediation: Complete the inventory and data map; enable data events

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; annual training; security channel
Trust center, DPA, BAA, MSA, system description, and questionnaire answers communicate commitments; customer notices per P08
evidence: Trust center capture; questionnaire sample; contact coverage report
gap: Three trust center and product statements are inaccurate; 5 of 10 questionnaires had inaccurate answers; security contacts for 71% of customers; system description lacks the healthcare cell and AI features (POAM-014, POAM-019)
remediation: Correct statements; lock the answer library; collect contacts; rewrite the system description for the 2027 scope

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives and principal service commitments defined in the system description
gap: Commitments for Confidentiality, the healthcare cell, and AI features are not yet in the system description
remediation: Updated system description and management assertion draft

control_description: Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment with appetite statements (P01)
Fraud risks considered in the risk assessment
gap: Fraud scenarios (service credit manipulation, payment change fraud, insider data sale) are not analyzed separately
remediation: Add fraud scenarios to P01 at the next review

control_description: Changes that could affect controls are identified and assessed
gap: Healthcare cell launch and the warehouse feed were not assessed when introduced (POAM-018)
remediation: Risk assessment trigger in design review and vendor onboarding

control_description: Annual independent assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm; continuous control monitoring in the GRC tool
evidence: P07 plan and results; GRC tool

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported quarterly to the audit committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the Moderate baseline with tailoring tied to risks (P02)
General IT controls over infrastructure, change, and access
gap: Emergency change path bypasses review; no configuration standard for search and legacy accounts (POAM-009, POAM-012)
remediation: Break-glass deploy approvals; issue STD-01

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-29; standards index
gap: 9 of 10 standards are due by 2026-12-31 and must operate from 2027-01-01
remediation: Issue the standards on schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Single sign-on, MFA, security keys, just-in-time access, encryption, tenant isolation in the application
evidence: P07 IA-2(1), SC-28 (satisfied); IA-5, AC-3 (other than satisfied)
gap: 9 long-lived cloud keys; tenant isolation one layer (POAM-002, POAM-003)
remediation: Federated credentials (2026-10-31); cross-tenant tests (2026-12-15); row-level security (2027-03-31, to be carved into the description if late)

control_description: HR-driven provisioning and deprovisioning through the identity provider
gap: 2 of 25 terminations late; 2 non-SSO contractor accounts (Type 2 exception 1; POAM-001)
remediation: Same-day HR entry; reconciliation; SSO enforced in source hosting

control_description: Role-based access, just-in-time production access, quarterly reviews
gap: 14 standing administrator roles; 140 warehouse users; Standard plan support view without customer approval; missed Q3 2025 review (Type 2 exception 3; POAM-007, POAM-008)
remediation: Remove standing roles; named analysts only; customer approval on all plans

control_description: Data center physical access inherited from the cloud provider; office badge access
evidence: Cloud provider SOC 2 report; badge reports

control_description: Laptop wipes with certificates; cloud media sanitization inherited
gap: Terminated tenants' attachments not disposed (POAM-017)
remediation: Deletion job extended; purge evidence

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: WAF and content delivery, private subnets, egress firewall, guardrails

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS everywhere; egress allow lists; DPAs for transfers to sub-processors
gap: Healthcare subject lines exported to the warehouse; healthcare egress to 2 subcontractors without BAAs (POAM-015, POAM-006)
remediation: Stop the export; restrict egress to BAA subcontractors

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all laptops; signed images verified at deploy; attachment malware scanning

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning, benchmark scans, penetration testing, bug bounty
gap: Critical findings fixed in 41 days median against 15; SSRF open since March 2026 (POAM-013)
remediation: Fix the SSRF; block deploys with aged critical findings

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: SIEM and MDR monitoring for endpoints, identity, and cloud control plane
gap: No data-level monitoring; simulated bulk download not detected; MDR excludes cloud workloads (POAM-004)
remediation: Data events, detections, MDR extension; repeat the simulated download

control_description: Security events triaged by the detection engineer and MDR; severity criteria in POL-03
gap: Support view sessions not reviewed; healthcare escalation criteria new
remediation: Monthly session review; train support and engineering on PHI escalation

control_description: Incident response per POL-03 and the P08 runbooks
gap: Runbooks approved 2026-09-29 but untested; contacts incomplete (POAM-014, POAM-020)
remediation: Tabletop 2026-11-10; contacts at 95% or more

control_description: Recovery from incidents per the P08 runbooks and DR runbooks
gap: Regional recovery took 9 hours; outage runbook untested (POAM-010)
remediation: Approved DR plan; exercise 2027-02-17

control_description: Pull request review, CI tests, signed images, deployment records
gap: 2 of 25 emergency changes without review or approval (Type 2 exception 2; POAM-009)
remediation: Two-person break-glass deploy; after-the-fact review in 1 business day

control_description: Business disruption risks in P01 and P05; cyber insurance
gap: Regional and destructive-attack recovery not proven (R-006, R-007)
remediation: Warm standby plan funded; write-once backups

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Sub-processor onboarding review, DPAs, BAAs, annual SOC 2 review (Part B)
gap: 2 subcontractors without BAAs; 3 of 14 sub-processor reviews still pending after readiness work; AI provider retention conflicts with commitments (POAM-006)
remediation: Sign or stop; finish reviews; zero-retention endpoint for all tenants

control_description: Capacity monitored with autoscaling and monthly capacity reviews
Backups, replicas, and DR region infrastructure
gap: Backups not write-once; DR region is a pilot light; search not replicated (POAM-010, POAM-011)
remediation: Write-once vault (2026-12-31); warm standby (2027-06-30, disclosed in the system description if not complete)

control_description: Recovery plan testing
gap: The only regional test failed its 4-hour objective, which is in the system description (Type 2 exception 4)
remediation: Revise the stated objective in the 2027 description to what is proven, or prove 4 hours at the 2027-02-17 exercise

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Confidential information identified and protected (POL-04 classification; encryption; access)
gap: Warehouse copy of ticket metadata; AI provider retention (POAM-015)
remediation: Counts-only warehouse feed; zero-retention endpoint

control_description: Confidential information disposed of to meet commitments (30-day deletion)
gap: 20 of 20 sampled terminated tenants still hold attachments (POAM-017)
remediation: Extend deletion; purge 61 tenants; monthly deletion report
